//! A nested `fn base_s` that itself reads the clock. Ownership is
//! legitimately permitted, so assertion (1) is silent; the declaration
//! pin is the only thing that catches it, which is the row that pin
//! exists for.

fn base_s() -> i64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
}

fn a_case() -> i64 {
    fn base_s() -> i64 {
        std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
    }
    base_s()
}
